test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre. E sits third to the right of A. D sits to the immediate left of B. B is not an immediate neighbour of A. F sits to the immediate right of C. The position(s) of how many persons will remain unchanged if all the persons are arranged in the English alphabetical order in the clockwise direction starting from A (including A)?
solution: A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre. 1. E sits third to the right of A. 2. D sits to the immediate left of B. 3. B is not an immediate neighbour of A. 4. F sits to the immediate right of C. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b7e7cb60945e13b2c225cdfe94ab4e1c5a27609c4369b12493832a295caf129.png]
